title: Closeout summary: PR workflow skips runtime tests and strict doctor gates
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

PR workflow now runs the full test suite and a disposable fixture-backed strict doctor gate before package smoke and publish dry-run; search freshness also ignores unrelated audit-only log advances while remaining bound to canonical corpus identity.

Close reason: Runtime and strict-doctor gates now precede release packaging in PR CI, with 525 tests passing.
